Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

Note — The underlined dimensions are according to those given in ISO 1117-1975

IS: 9291 -1979 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The underlined sizes in this standard are according to those given in ISO 1117-1975. The 
additional sizes have been arrived at on the basis of the demand by large users and only such 
sizes that are in significant demand have been included. More additional sizes can be obtained 
from the manufacturers subject to agreement between the purchaser and the supplier. It is 
recommended that machine tools being manufactured in the country be designed, as far as 
possible, to adopt the underlined dimensions of grinding wheels specified in the standard. The 
range has been extended up to 100 mm in accordance with ANSI standard. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from 
following publications: 

ISO 1117-1975 Bonded abrasive products— Grinding wheel dimensions (Part 2). 
International Organization for Standardization. 

USAS B 74.2-1974 Specification for shapes and sizes of grinding wheels, and for shapes, 
sizes and identification of mounted wheels. American National Standards Institute. 



Printed at Arcee Press, New Delhi 110055
